newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 26.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

** On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped on profit-taking to end at 5,722.74, off 10.73 points as investors, burnt by the recent rout of small stocks, sought safety with companies with proven records.
For the week, it was up 33.29 points.

** Tobacco shares on the New York Stock Exchange are set to rally this week after a jury ruled in favour of four cigarette makers in a liability suit, overshadowing, so far as markets are concerned, the Democratic Convention kicking off on Monday and President Clinton's moves to discourage young smokers.
** The Jakarta composite index closed up 4.93 points, or 0.91 percent, at 549.21 points on Friday on the back of active buying by local and foreign operators following an easing in political tension.
** On Monday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,342.60/43.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,342.75/43.50.
** Garment firm Great River and Bank Niaga on announcements of rises of their first six months' net profit.
** Property firm Duta Anggada on news reports of a strategic alliance with Singapore-based property firm Hong Leong Group.
** Jembo Cable on market talk of possible acquisitions.
** Private-owned Bank Duta on market talk it is obtaining fresh syndicated loans, the likelihood of a management reshuffle and fresh equity injection.
